dedupe_keys.name: uk zone level dwelling occupancy profiles from time use diaries

description: The zone-wise occupancy deposit contains 5,376 day-level availability schedules derived from the UK Time Use Survey 2014–2015. Building-performance researchers converted activity diaries recorded at ten-minute intervals into occupancy profiles grouped by dwelling type, occupant count, month and weekday. Mendeley version 2 lists CSV profiles and licenses them under CC BY 4.0 with free access. The producer explicitly describes their use with EnergyPlus. Coverage is a set of survey-derived dwelling categories, not sensor observations in a named building or a current occupancy census. Known limitations include activity-to-zone conversion and aggregation, which restrict interpretation for individual households. A reviewer-assessed use is testing occupancy-sensitive heating and electricity demand in building simulations. model-energyplus is the documented target environment, and model-occdem-occupancy-demand-profiles offers a related profile-generation approach. The review did not download the files, check zone labels or verify direct import into either model.
